description:
Deliverables:
- Move clustered failover from in-memory-only recovery to Bedrock-backed recovery using Jido.Cluster.Storage.Bedrock.
- Support handoff and crash failover where the new owner can thaw durable state instead of depending only on standby memory.

Acceptance:
- A two-node clustered singleton can survive owner loss and planned handoff with Bedrock configured.
- Acknowledged state is preserved across restart and failover.
title: Implement durable Bedrock-backed singleton failover
